voice.summary: Sounds like an invitation on heavy paper: short, polite and sure of itself. It implies access without boasting and speaks to investors as peers, never as leads.
dos: Address the reader as a peer
State facts like 400+ members and stop
Use a refined, short call to action
donts: Do not use hype or FOMO language

taglines: An invitation to invest with peers
boilerplate: ClubX is a private club for technology investors, bringing more than 400 members together to share deals, back founders and build lasting relationships across finance and tech.

microcopy.success: Request received. We'll be in touch.
